# Logo and icons {.page-title}

::: {.lede}
The logo follows a tagged fish across ocean layers that run from warm at the top to cold at the bottom, under a breaking wave. A burst of tail beats from an accelerometer sits on the track, and an acoustic ping marks the last detection. Lab members and students are welcome to use these files for talks and posters.
:::

## Colours

::: {.column-page}
```{=html}
<div class="logo-swatches">
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#A4471F"></span>#A4471F</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#BA7040"></span>#BA7040</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#AB9A4F"></span>#AB9A4F</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#5E8A70"></span>#5E8A70</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#2E637A"></span>#2E637A</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#1F3F5B"></span>#1F3F5B</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#17293A"></span>#17293A navy</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#2A5C7A"></span>#2A5C7A harbour</div>
  <div><span class="sw" style="background:#E8EDF0"></span>#E8EDF0 steel</div>
</div>
```
:::

The six band colours run from warm to cold, top to bottom. Navy is used for the track and text, harbour blue for the nodes and links, and steel for page bands. The headings are set in Crimson Pro and the labels in Public Sans.
